hooks.command: A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook SessionStart; exit 0
A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook UserPromptSubmit; exit 0
A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook PreToolUse; exit 0
A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook PostToolUse; exit 0
A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook PostToolUseFailure; exit 0
A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook SubagentStart; exit 0
A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook SubagentStop; exit 0
A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook Stop; exit 0
A="${AGENTOPS_BIN:-agentops}"; command -v "$A" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$A" hook SessionEnd; exit 0
